20261103CO84939.description: Colorado Amendment 81. Requires law officers to notify federal immigration authorities of people charged with violent crimes.
20261103CO84939.summary: This proposed amendment to Colorado's constitution would require law enforcement officers to notify the U.S. Department of Homeland Security when charging people with violent crimes or, for those with prior felonies, any crime if they may be in the U.S. illegally.
20261103CO84939.seatName: 81 - Require law enforcement to coordinate with DHS regarding immigration status

20261103CO84941.description: Colorado Proposition 132. Increases penalties for fentanyl crimes.
20261103CO84941.summary: This ballot measure would increase criminal penalties for the possession, manufacture and sale of fentanyl.

20261103CO84942.description: Colorado Proposition 133. Increases penalties for child sex trafficking.
20261103CO84942.summary: This ballot measure would require a sentence of life in prison without parole for people convicted of trafficking a child for sexual activity.

20261103CO84943.description: Colorado Proposition NN. Raises the state revenue cap to spend more on education.
20261103CO84943.summary: This ballot measure would raise the state's revenue cap and spend additional money on education to raise teacher pay, reduce class sizes and increase access to career and technical courses.
20261103CO84943.seatName: NN - Increase TABOR revenue cap for K-12 funding

20261103CO84944.description: Colorado Proposition 135. Bars surgeries that alter a minor's sex characteristics.
20261103CO84944.summary: This ballot measure would prohibit surgeries to alter a minor's sex characteristics in response to the child's perceived gender or sex. It also would prohibit state funding for such surgeries.

20261103CO84945.description: Colorado Proposition 134. Limits transgender athletes in school sports.
20261103CO84945.summary: This ballot measure would prohibit people with male reproductive systems from participating on female athletic teams at schools.
20261103CO84945.seatName: 134 - Require school sports participation based on biological sex

20261103CO85020.description: Colorado Amendment 82. Creates a right to use natural gas in homes and businesses.
20261103CO85020.summary: This proposed amendment to Colorado's constitution would create a right to use natural gas for cooking and heating in homes and businesses.
20261103CO85020.seatName: 82 - Establish right to purchase and sell natural gas

20261103CO85100.description: Colorado Amendment 83. Creates a right to hunt and fish.
20261103CO85100.summary: This proposed amendment to Colorado's constitution would create a right to hunt and fish by traditional methods.
20261103CO85100.seatName: 83 - Establish constitutional right to hunt and fish

20261103CO85101.description: Colorado Proposition 136. Limits state income tax rates.
20261103CO85101.summary: This ballot measure would cap the state individual and corporate income tax rate at 4.4%.
20261103CO85101.seatName: 136 - Cap individual and corporate income tax at 4.4%

20261103CO85102.seatName: Denver At Large B Unexpired Term

20261103CO85103.description: Colorado Proposition 137. Earmarks sporting goods sales tax revenues for outdoor programs.
20261103CO85103.summary: This ballot measure would exempt sales taxes on sporting goods from the state's revenue cap and earmark the money for wildfire prevention, water conservation and outdoor recreation efforts.
20261103CO85103.seatName: 137 - Use sporting goods sales tax revenue for environmental conservation

20261103CO85137.description: Colorado Amendment 84. Requires government-issued identification numbers when voting by mail.
20261103CO85137.summary: This proposed amendment to Colorado's constitution would require people voting by mail to provide the last four digits of a government-issued identification number along with their signature.
20261103CO85137.seatName: 84 - Require voter signature and identification number on the outside of mail ballots

20261103CO85138.description: Colorado Amendment 85. Requires ballot questions to use plain wording.
20261103CO85138.summary: This proposed amendment to Colorado's constitution would require ballot questions to be written in plain language at no greater than an eighth-grade reading level.
20261103CO85138.seatName: 85 - Require ballot questions to be written in plain language

20261103CO85139.description: Colorado Amendment 86. Restricts mid-decade congressional redistricting.
20261103CO85139.summary: This proposed amendment to Colorado's constitution would prohibit any congressional redistricting done for the 2028 election from favoring one political party and would require approval from an independent commission and the state Supreme Court.

20261103CO85140.description: Colorado Amendment 87. Imposes a graduated state income tax.
20261103CO85140.summary: This proposed amendment to Colorado's constitution would end the state's flat income tax rate and impose a graduated income tax, ranging from 3.7% for income below $25,000 to 8.4% for income over $1 million. Increased revenue would go to public schools, early childhood programs and healthcare.
20261103CO85140.seatName: 87 - Replace the uniform income tax rate with a graduated tax structure
